verses.text_urhobo: Nẹ Etiyin Ebraham de mu oyan ọ da garo ni ẹbẹre ri Nẹgẹb, ọ da ra dia uvwre ri Kadẹsh vi Shur, ubrakpọ ri Gẹra kọye o de di muẹ yan.
verses.text_romanized: ne etiyin ebraham de mu oyan o da garo ni ebere ri negeb o da ra dia uvwre ri kadesh vi shur ubrakpo ri gera koye o de di mue yan

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da ta kẹ Sera rẹ aye rọye, Wẹ oniọvo mẹ, Abimẹlẹk ovie ri Gẹra de ji ukọ ra reyọ Sera.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta ke sera re aye roye we oniovo me abimelek ovie ri gera de ji uko ra reyo sera

verses.text_urhobo: Ẹkẹvuọvo Ọghẹnẹ de bru Abimẹlẹk rhe vwẹ evwerhẹ vwẹ ason, ọ da ta kẹ, Nighe, orivwi wọ epha na, fiki rẹ aye ru wọ reyọre na, kidie aye rẹ ohwo ọfa o ruẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ekevuovo oghene de bru abimelek rhe vwe evwerhe vwe ason o da ta ke nighe orivwi wo epha na fiki re aye ru wo reyore na kidie aye re ohwo ofa o rue

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke yena yẹ Abimẹlẹk ji si kẹrẹ-ẹ, Etiyin ọ da ta Ọrovwohwo, ku wo di hwe ohwo ekueku?
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke yena ye abimelek ji si kere e etiyin o da ta orovwohwo ku wo di hwe ohwo ekueku

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ dianẹ ọye ọvo re ta kẹ vwẹ nẹ, Oniọvo mẹ? Okpuyovwi rẹ aye na da je tanẹ, Oniọvo mẹ. Vwẹ ọvwata rẹ udu mẹ kugbe abọ ọfuanfon mẹ ọye mi vwo ru ọna.
verses.text_romanized: o diane oye ovo re ta ke vwe ne oniovo me okpuyovwi re aye na da je tane oniovo me vwe ovwata re udu me kugbe abo ofuanfon me oye mi vwo ru ona

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ọghẹnẹ da ta kẹ vwẹ evun rẹ evwerhẹ, Uyota, Me riẹnre nẹ evun ọfuanfon wo vwo ru Ọnana, yẹ omẹvwẹ re sorọ ru wo vwo jẹ umwemwu eruo kpahọ ovwẹ, fiki rẹ ọtiọye na mi gbi ji wọ vwẹ obọ te-e.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin oghene da ta ke vwe evun re evwerhe uyota me rienre ne evun ofuanfon wo vwo ru onana ye omevwe re soro ru wo vwo je umwemwu eruo kpaho ovwe fiki re otioye na mi gbi ji wo vwe obo te e

verses.text_urhobo: Gba vwẹ aye rẹ ohwo na vwọ kẹ; fikiridie ọmraro o ruẹ, kọ nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ wẹ, kọye wọ rhọre. Ẹkẹvuọvo wọ rha vwọ kẹ-ẹ, gba riẹn tanẹ ughwu kọye wo ghwu, wẹ kugbe ekru wẹn ejobi.
verses.text_romanized: gba vwe aye re ohwo na vwo ke fikiridie omraro o rue ko ne erhovwo ke we koye wo rhore ekevuovo wo rha vwo ke e gba rien tane ughwu koye wo ghwu we kugbe ekru wen ejobi

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Abimẹlẹk de vrẹn vwẹ irhiọke ride, o de se idibo rọye, o de gbe ikun nana ejobi kẹ ayen, oshọ de mu ayen gangan.
verses.text_romanized: koye abimelek de vren vwe irhioke ride o de se idibo roye o de gbe ikun nana ejobi ke ayen osho de mu ayen gangan

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Abimẹlẹk de se Ebraham, ọ da ta kẹ, Die wo ru kẹ avwanre na? Kidie mi ru we, ru wọ vwọ nẹrhẹ ovwẹ vẹ uvie mẹ ru umwemwu rode tiọnana? Wo ru obo rẹ ohwo e ru-u vwọ kẹ vwẹ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin abimelek de se ebraham o da ta ke die wo ru ke avwanre na kidie mi ru we ru wo vwo nerhe ovwe ve uvie me ru umwemwu rode tionana wo ru obo re ohwo e ru u vwo ke vwe

verses.text_urhobo: Abimẹlẹk da ta kẹ Ebraham, Die wo rori vwo ru emu nana?
verses.text_romanized: abimelek da ta ke ebraham die wo rori vwo ru emu nana

verses.text_urhobo: Ebraham da ta, Mi ruro fikiridie mi rori nẹ, Oshọ ẹdjẹ rẹ Ọghẹnẹ ọ etinẹ-ẹ, ayen de rhe hwe vwe fiki rẹ aye mẹ.
verses.text_romanized: ebraham da ta mi ruro fikiridie mi rori ne osho edje re oghene o etine e ayen de rhe hwe vwe fiki re aye me

verses.text_urhobo: Uyota oniọvo mẹ o ghine ruẹ, ọmọtẹ rẹ ọsẹ mẹ ẹkẹvuọvo ọ dia ọmọ rẹ oni mẹ-ẹ, kọye mi de vwo ru aye.
verses.text_romanized: uyota oniovo me o ghine rue omote re ose me ekevuovo o dia omo re oni me e koye mi de vwo ru aye

verses.text_urhobo: Vwẹ ọke rẹ Ọghẹnẹ vwọ tani mi suosuo nẹ uwevwi rẹ ọsẹ mẹ, Me da ta kẹ, Ọnana kọye ẹse ri wo ru kẹ vwẹ, kasan kasan rẹ avwanre yan te, gba ta kpahọ vwẹ nẹ, Oniọvo mẹ o ruẹ.
verses.text_romanized: vwe oke re oghene vwo tani mi suosuo ne uwevwi re ose me me da ta ke onana koye ese ri wo ru ke vwe kasan kasan re avwanre yan te gba ta kpaho vwe ne oniovo me o rue

verses.text_urhobo: Kọye Abimẹlẹk da reyọ ogodẹ vẹ irhuẹn kugbe eviẹn rẹ eshare vẹ erẹ eya, ọ da vwẹ ayen kẹ Ebraham, o de siobọ nẹ Sera rẹ aye rọye na vwọ kẹ.
verses.text_romanized: koye abimelek da reyo ogode ve irhuen kugbe evien re eshare ve ere eya o da vwe ayen ke ebraham o de siobo ne sera re aye roye na vwo ke

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Abimẹlẹk da ta, Nighe, otọ mẹ na rhie phihọ kẹ wẹ, asan ro je we vwọ gba dia.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin abimelek da ta nighe oto me na rhie phiho ke we asan ro je we vwo gba dia

verses.text_urhobo: Ọ da ta kẹ Sera nẹ, Nighe, Me vwẹ ikpahọ ujori ihwe rẹ idọnọ efuanfon vwọ kẹ oniọvo wẹn re, Ọnana igho rẹ arhuẹrẹ wẹn vwọ kẹ ihwo rẹ ovwan, kohwo kohwo rẹ oma wẹn ejobi Me vẹ ayen rhuẹrẹ kugbe.
verses.text_romanized: o da ta ke sera ne nighe me vwe ikpaho ujori ihwe re idono efuanfon vwo ke oniovo wen re onana igho re arhuere wen vwo ke ihwo re ovwan kohwo kohwo re oma wen ejobi me ve ayen rhuere kugbe

verses.text_urhobo: Etiyin Ebraham da nẹ ẹrhovwo kẹ Ọghẹnẹ, Ọghẹnẹ de sivwi Abimẹlẹk, o de ji sivwi aye rọye kugbe eviẹn rẹ eya ro vwori ejobi, kọye ayen de vwiẹ emọ.
verses.text_romanized: etiyin ebraham da ne erhovwo ke oghene oghene de sivwi abimelek o de ji sivwi aye roye kugbe evien re eya ro vwori ejobi koye ayen de vwie emo

verses.text_urhobo: Fikiridie Ọrovwohwo bru eya rẹ uwevwi rẹ Abimẹlẹk uvwiẹ fiki ri Sera rẹ aye rẹ Ebraham rọ reyọre.
verses.text_romanized: fikiridie orovwohwo bru eya re uwevwi re abimelek uvwie fiki ri sera re aye re ebraham ro reyore
